title: Accounts Assistant
description:
ACCOUNTS ASSISTANT / FINANCE ASSISTANT

SEVENOAKS (HYBRID AFTER PROBATION)

£33,000 to £35,000 + BONUS + BENEFITS

THE OPPORTUNITY:
We're partnering with a well-established and growing international business that is looking to recruit an experienced Accounts Assistant / Finance Assistant to join their established finance team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with solid accounts experience who is looking for a role with greater responsibility and ownership. This is not an entry-level position, so the successful candidate will already have strong hands-on experience with cashbook management, bank reconciliations and general finance processes.
Initially working from the Sevenoaks office during the training and onboarding period, the position will move to a hybrid working arrangement once fully settled into the role.

THE ACCOUNTS ASSISTANT / FINANCE ASSISTANT ROLE:
- Reporting into the finance team, taking responsibility for the day-to-day management of the cashbook
- Completing daily bank and financial reconciliations, ensuring transactions are accurately recorded and balanced
- Investigating discrepancies and unidentified transactions, taking ownership through to resolution
- Processing supplier and overhead invoices and ensuring payments are made accurately and on time
- Monitoring incoming payments and supporting the reconciliation of sales and commission income
- Assisting with month-end processes and preparing information for monthly management reporting
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring transactions are correctly allocated within the system
- Responding to finance queries from colleagues across the business
- Working with high volumes of financial transactions and ensuring accuracy is maintained at all times
- Supporting the wider Accounts team with ad hoc finance duties and ensuring the smooth running of the department

THE PERSON:
- Current experience within an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant, Accounts Administrator, Assistant Accountant or similar role
- Strong hands-on experience with cashbook management and bank reconciliations is essential
- Confident investigating reconciliation differences and resolving discrepancies independently
- Experience processing supplier invoices, payments and general transactional finance activities
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, with experience using spreadsheets for reconciliations and financial data
- Experience working within a high-volume or multi-currency environment would be advantageous, but is not essential
- Excellent attention to detail with the ability to maintain a high level of accuracy when working to deadlines
- Strong communication skills with the confidence to liaise with colleagues across the business
- Able to manage priorities, work independently and take ownership of key finance processes
- A proactive and adaptable individual who enjoys working as part of a busy finance team

TO APPLY:
Please send your CV for the Accounts Assistant / Finance Assistant role via the advert for immediate consideration.

description:
Accounts Assistant

Maternity Cover - 10 months
£32,000 - £38,000
Office based, Monday to Friday

We are currently recruiting for a Accounts Assistant to join a well-established UK-based manufacturing business based in East Kent.

This is a varied role offering the opportunity to work across a broad range of day-to-day finance activities, supporting the wider finance function and working closely with colleagues across the business.

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV is essential , as this is the system used throughout the role.

As Finance Assistant, you will be responsible for supporting the smooth running of the accounts function, with duties covering areas such as:
- Managing customer and supplier accounts, including account set-up and ongoing maintenance.
- Supporting credit control and following up outstanding customer payments.
- Preparing debtor information and regular financial reports for management.
- Processing sales and purchase invoices, credit notes and customer statements.

- Processing delivery documentation, supplier invoices and customer remittances through NAV.
- Maintaining accurate records relating to timber deliveries and stock movements.
- Supporting the monthly payroll process, including PAYE/CIS payments and relevant deductions.
- Processing staff expenses and reimbursements.
- Responding to finance-related queries from customers, suppliers and internal colleagues.
- Supporting month-end processes and providing information to Group Accounts.
- Assisting with internal and external audit requirements.
- General finance administration, including maintaining accurate electronic and paper records.

The successful candidate will have/be:
- Previous experience in an accounts/finance position.
- Hands-on experience using Microsoft Dynamics NAV 2015 - essential.
- Good understanding of general accounts processes.
- Experience with invoicing, reconciliations, credit control and payments.
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Are you an experienced Bookkeeper looking for a varied role in a friendly and supportive environment?

AMR Bookkeeping Solutions is a growing bookkeeping and payroll business based in Tonbridge, Kent. We provide professional bookkeeping, payroll and financial support to a wide range of businesses, including sole traders, contractors, freelancers, SMEs, limited companies and accountancy practices.

We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Bookkeeper to join our team on a full time basis. This is a varied, client-facing role involving day-to-day bookkeeping, VAT and CIS returns, management accounts and credit control.

Why Join AMR Bookkeeping Solutions?

At AMR, we believe that our people are at the heart of the service we provide. We offer a professional yet relaxed working environment where your skills and experience are valued.

We offer:
- Hybrid working (after probation)
- Flexible working hours
- BUPA Cashplan benefit
- Pension
- Staff incentives
- Death in service benefit
- Free onsite parking
- Casual dress
- Staff parties/socials
- Modern open plan office
- Break area

Our team works with a wide range of clients and uses leading accounting software including Xero, Sage, QuickBooks and FreeAgent. We pride ourselves on providing a professional, approachable and personal service to our clients.

About The Role

As a Bookkeeper at AMR Bookkeeping Solutions, your responsibilities will include:
- Completing day-to-day bookkeeping for a portfolio of clients.
- Processing and reconciling financial transactions and maintaining accurate accounting records.
- Preparing and submitting VAT returns.
- Preparing and submitting CIS returns.
- Preparing management accounts and financial reports for clients.
- Providing credit control services and helping clients manage outstanding payments.
- Supporting clients with their accounting and bookkeeping requirements using Xero and other accounting software.
- Liaising directly with clients to resolve queries relating to bookkeeping, VAT, CIS and financial records.
- Visiting client premises, where required, and providing a professional, friendly and knowledgeable service.
- Working closely with colleagues to ensure client work is completed accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Keeping up to date with relevant HMRC requirements, VAT rules, CIS requirements and accounting legislation.

About You

We are looking for someone who is organised, accurate, reliable and client-focused, with a genuine interest in bookkeeping and helping businesses maintain accurate and useful financial information.

You should be comfortable working independently but also enjoy being part of a supportive team. You will need to be able to communicate confidently with clients and manage a varied workload across multiple businesses.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience working as a Bookkeeper or in a similar accounts role.
- Strong practical experience using Xero is essential.
- Experience with Sage, QuickBooks and FreeAgent would be advantageous, although training can be provided where required.
- Good understanding of double-entry bookkeeping, VAT and financial record keeping.
- Experience preparing VAT returns and CIS returns is highly desirable.
- Experience of payroll processing would be advantageous.
- Ideally, experience working within an accountancy or bookkeeping practice, or in a role managing the accounts of multiple clients.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Able to manage your own workload, work independently and use your own initiative, while knowing when to ask for support.
- Comfortable working to deadlines and managing competing priorities.
- Good organisational and time-management skills.
- Confident communicating with clients and able to explain bookkeeping, VAT and accounting matters clearly.
- Willingness to learn, develop your skills and keep up to date with changes in accounting and tax legislation.
- Full driving licence, as the role may involve visiting clients at their premises.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Bookkeeper, Client Bookkeeper, Practice Bookkeeper or Accounts Assistant looking to develop their career within an established bookkeeping practice.

Our Recruitment Process

We want to make sure that the role is right for both you and AMR Bookkeeping Solutions.

The first stage of our interview process, shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a practical, journal-based bookkeeping assessment. This is designed to assess your practical bookkeeping knowledge and understanding.

Depending on the outcome of the bookkeeping assessment, successful candidates will then be invited to a face-to-face interview at our Tonbridge office. This will give us an opportunity to get to know you better, discuss your experience and answer any questions you may have about the role and working with AMR Bookkeeping Solutions.

How to Apply

If you are an experienced Bookkeeper looking for a varied, client-facing role in a supportive and professional environment, we would love to hear from you.

Please email your CV to Caroline Goodsell at (url removed) to apply for the position.

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted regarding the next stage of the recruitment process.
